substances.name: Dequalinium chloride
substances.clinicalNote: Exact Decatrin product and dosage form must be verified. Lozenge, oral gel and other local formulations must not share a dose automatically.

substances.name: Dexamethasone + neomycin ophthalmic
substances.clinicalNote: Steroid-containing ophthalmic combinations are not a generic bacterial-conjunctivitis treatment. Viral/fungal eye disease, corneal epithelial disease, glaucoma/IOP risk and product-specific contraindications require screening.

substances.name: Chloramphenicol ophthalmic
doseCandidates: Acute bacterial conjunctivitis age >=2 years, ointment alone: about 1 cm to affected eye(s) 3–4 times/day for 5 days
substances.clinicalNote: If eye drops are used in daytime, the same source permits ointment at night; product contraindications and red-flag eye symptoms still govern use.

substances.name: Vitamin B complex
substances.clinicalNote: No universal '1 amp IV/IM daily' rule: thiamine/riboflavin/niacinamide/pyridoxine content and licensed indications vary by product.

substances.name: Ascorbic acid (Vitamin C)
substances.clinicalNote: DRX does not encode 'immunity', stress or gingival bleeding as universal IV indications. Oral and parenteral products require route- and deficiency-specific evidence.

substances.name: Pyridoxine (Vitamin B6)
substances.clinicalNote: Pyridoxine may have specific deficiency/drug-related indications, but the raw claim 'use Bedoxin to take patients off diazepam' is excluded as unsupported.

substances.name: Multivitamin
substances.clinicalNote: Dose follows the exact marketed product and age label; no generic one-tablet prescription rule is published.

substances.name: Probiotic drops
substances.clinicalNote: A generic 5–10 drop/day rule is not portable between probiotic products. Strain, CFU, age and manufacturer label must be stored before dosing.

substances.name: Sambucol Immuno
substances.clinicalNote: Not treated as a prescription-drug dosing rule. Dose must come from the exact product label by age/formulation.

substances.name: Pediacide cough syrup
activeIngredients: Exact herbal formulation requires product verification
substances.clinicalNote: The raw 2.5–5 mL 2–3x/day instruction is not published generically. Ivy/plantain/althaea/thyme content, concentration and minimum age can differ by product.
